name: Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard
description: Published by DSIT/Central Digital and Data Office. A structured template for publicly documenting how an algorithmic/AI tool used by a public sector body works, its data, oversight, and risks — the UK's answer to a public AI system-card registry. Mandatory since February 2024 for UK government departments/public bodies using algorithmic tools affecting the public.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by United Kingdom Government (gov.uk) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within United Kingdom Government (gov.uk).
